statement: An array of distinct integers was sorted in ascending order and then rotated to the right some number of times k. One right rotation moves the last element to the front.
Given the rotated array nums, return k, the number of right rotations that were applied.
After k right rotations the smallest element sits at index k, so the task is to find the index of the minimum. Do it with binary search in O(log n) time.

examples.explanation: The minimum, 1, is at index 3. Rotating [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] right three times gives exactly this array.
The array is already sorted and its minimum is at index 0, so it was rotated 0 times.
